section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1975
title: 27 The volume of suicides for Metropolitan Cities as a whole was 6.51 per lakh of population. Bangalore topped the list with 21.02 suicides per lakh of population. The minimum volume of suicides was 1.26 for Calcutta city. The volume of suicides per lakh of population among the Metropolitan Cities ranged between 21.02 and 1.26.
